description: Renovate is disabled here deliberately. This repository was last developed on
2017-04-13 and is kept for reference, not maintained.
Nothing in the build can move. hive-exec 1.2.1 and hadoop-core 1.2.1 are the
Hadoop 1.x / Hive 1.2 line, scrypto 1.1.0 is from the same era, and one of the
resolvers is http://conjars.org/repo -- plain HTTP, and conjars no longer
serves. There is no CI, so nothing would catch a bump that breaks the build.
What Renovate proposed in six PRs, and why each was refused:
#2 hive-exec  1.2.1 -> 1.2.2     last release of a dead line; no reason to take it
#7 hive-exec  1.2.1 -> 4.x       eight years of breaking change, on no tests
#3 scalatest  2.2.4 -> 2.2.6     test-only, on a build that cannot resolve
#8 scalatest  2.2.4 -> 3.x       different API; every test would need rewriting
have no 2.13 artifacts, and #5 contradicts it
#5 and #6 being open at once is the clearest sign this is not a repository
Renovate can reason about: it offered two mutually exclusive Scala lines. It
then offered both the minor and the major for hive-exec and for scalatest.
If this is ever revived, the move is a fresh build definition on a current
Scala and Spark, not a chain of bumps from here. Delete this file then.
